Hypothyroidism

cards.alt: Hypothyroidism adds weight through a slowed metabolism, fluid retention, and the fatigue that reduces daily movement

title: How
Hypothyroidism
Is Diagnosed
cards.alt: Hypothyroidism is diagnosed with a TSH test, a Free T4 test, and thyroid antibody tests where Hashimoto's is suspected

steps.label: TSH
steps.note: The most sensitive test, high means underactive

steps.label: Free T4
steps.note: A low level supports the diagnosis
